credibility_flags.claim: Has dabbled in robotics, fintech, and social apps
credibility_flags.why_flagged: Founder explicitly stated he cannot name a single arcane pain point in any of these verticals that insiders would recognise. Market Edge probe failed by self-report. Downstream skills should treat 'domain experience' as zero and steer toward markets where he is the user (developer tools, solo-dev infra).

credibility_flags.claim: Can read a paper in any of these spaces
credibility_flags.why_flagged: Consumption-level familiarity is not Insight. No prior-attempt-analysis, no non-obvious market thesis, and no named practitioner interviews surfaced in any vertical except his own (dev-tools). Downstream skills should require an explicit idea-maze pass before scoring Insight above baseline.

credibility_flags.claim: Could ship a prototype of basically any B2B SaaS idea in 72 hours with auth, billing, and a passable UI
credibility_flags.why_flagged: Technical capability probe passed clearly (Raft, K8s, compiler, OSS). This is not a credibility flag on skill. It IS a flag that shipping speed is being used as a substitute for market selection — the 'build anything' confidence masks the absence of a buyer and a domain. Flagging under insight, not skill_edge, because the risk is idea-selection, not execution.

credibility_flags.claim: Has never stuck with any one thing; always had a new idea by the time the current one needed sales or polish or operations
credibility_flags.why_flagged: Self-disclosed focus/persistence risk. Downstream skills should weight stage_preference '0_to_1' heavily and flag mis-fit for any idea that requires a 12+ month grind through the non-building phases (enterprise GTM, regulated markets, content moats). This is constraint-shaped, not deceit.

credibility_flags.claim: I don't know anyone in any specific industry — zero warm intros in healthcare, finance, legal, or manufacturing
credibility_flags.why_flagged: Founder was admirably explicit about cold-start status. Not dishonesty — recording as a flag so downstream skills de-prioritise markets that require insider-sold first customers. Dev-tools / solo-dev infra is the one vertical where his community capital substitutes for warm intros; everywhere else he is starting from zero.
